description: This file defines a report for manufacturing work order consumed materials in ERPNext, including functions to fetch data, define columns, and apply filters.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes work order items data based on filters.

methods.name: get_fields
methods.description: Returns list of database fields to retrieve for the report.

methods.name: get_filter_condition
methods.description: Constructs filter conditions for database query based on report filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report output.
